content.short: We aim to raise awareness on marine animal welfare, conservation, and environmental protection through the medium of digital art.
content.description:
We are a small team of artists who aim to raise awareness on marine animal welfare, conservation, and environmental protection through the medium of digital art.

Each series is a new marine animal of various species, historically consistent with its rarity. Each animal is equipped with fun / quirky accessories, making it completely unique. 20% of sales of every drop goes towards Marine Conservation, through NGOs.
